facts.text: Built and ran Spark batch pipelines on Databricks processing ~4 TB/day for a retail analytics platform, writing to Delta tables.
Led migration of 120 Airflow DAGs to generated DAGs, cutting authoring time by 60%.
Designed Kafka event streaming with schema registry and dead-letter queues, sustaining 25k events/s.
Owned a dbt project of 300 models on BigQuery with CI-enforced tests.
Managed GCP infrastructure (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GCS) as Terraform across 3 environments.
Led a team of 5 engineers: mentoring, code review and delivery planning.
Shipped an LLM document-extraction agent to production with schema validation, bounded self-correction and an evaluation set, reaching 92% field-level accuracy.
Built a RAG pipeline over 1,500 biomedical abstracts with a vector store and a code-enforced citation guardrail (portfolio project).
Built a read-only MCP server exposing literature search to LLM clients, 28 tests (portfolio project).
Built a LangGraph duplicate-ticket detector evaluated on a public benchmark (portfolio project).
Containerised services with Docker and automated build, test and deploy with GitHub Actions.
Added Prometheus and Grafana monitoring with SLO-based alerting to data pipelines.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas and tuned queries, cutting p95 latency from 1.8s to 300ms.
Loaded data into Neo4j and wrote basic Cypher queries; not a specialism.
Ported a lakehouse reconciliation platform to Delta Lake and logged runs to MLflow, 34 tests (portfolio project).
Built AWS ETL on S3, Lambda and Glue for two years.
Served ML features through a containerised FastAPI service.
Built an Iceberg and Trino medallion lakehouse with reconciliation controls, 111 tests (portfolio project).
Deployed services to Kubernetes using Helm charts maintained by the platform team; did not operate clusters.
